message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

name: CI

jobs:
  all-succeeded:
    name: All Succeeded
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
    - test-linux
    - test-non-linux
    - lint
    - test-generated

    steps:
      - name: Check if all jubs succeeded
        uses: re-actors/alls-green@release/v1
        with:
          jobs: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}

  test-linux:
    name: Test Linux
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        rust:
          - stable
          - beta
          - nightly
        mb_const_generics:
          - ""
          - "--features const-generics"
        target:
          - x86_64
          - i686
          - sparc64
        include:
          - mb_const_generics: ""
            rust: 1.41.0
            target: x86_64
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - if: matrix.rust == '1.41.0'
        # Rust 1.41 doesn't like modern lock files :(
        run: rm Cargo.lock
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust }}
      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ matrix.rust }}-${{ matrix.target }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ matrix.rust }}-${{ matrix.target }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ matrix.rust }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - uses: actions-rs/cargo@v1
        with:
          use-cross: ${{ matrix.target != 'x86_64' }}
          command: test
          args: --verbose --features "strict" ${{ matrix.mb_const_generics }} --target ${{ matrix.target }}-unknown-linux-gnu
      - uses: actions-rs/cargo@v1
        with:
          use-cross: ${{ matrix.target != 'x86_64' }}
          command: doc
          args: --features "strict" ${{ matrix.mb_const_generics }} --target ${{ matrix.target }}-unknown-linux-gnu

  test-non-linux:
    name: Test non-Linux
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os:
          - macos-latest
          - windows-latest
        rust:
          - stable
        mb_const_generics:
          - ""
          - "--features const-generics"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust }}
      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ matrix.rust }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ matrix.rust }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@v2
      - run: just test ${{ matrix.mb_const_generics }}

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-nightly-lint-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-nightly-lint-
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@v2
      - run: just lint

  test-generated:
    name: Test Generated
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-stable-generated-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-stable-generated-
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@v2
      - run: just gen
      - run: git diff --exit-code",
  "rationale": "Add Cargo dependency caching via actions/cache@v4 to all Rust jobs. The repository has a committed Cargo.lock (pinned dependencies) and runs CI on every push/PR to main, so dependency downloads are repeated on every run and no cache currently exists. This matches P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads): cache the dependency download state (~/.cargo/registry, ~/.cargo/git) plus the build target directory, keyed on runner OS, toolchain/target, and Cargo.lock hash, while keeping every installation and test step unchanged. Cache keys are scoped per job/matrix entry to avoid cross-contamination, and restore-keys provide fallback hits. All build and test coverage is preserved; no permissions are weakened, no secrets or deployment actions are added, and no new network access beyond GitHub's built-in cache service is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
